shellCommands.command: for f in /workspace/pages/404.js /workspace/pages/_app.js /workspace/pages/_document.js /workspace/pages/_error.js /workspace/pages/index.js /workspace/pages/blog/\[id\].js /workspace/pages/blog/index.js /workspace/pages/api/posts/\[id\].js /workspace/pages/api/posts/index.js /workspace/components/AppProvider.js /workspace/next.config.ts /workspace/tsconfig.json; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

(npm start & echo $! > /tmp/next.pid; sleep 5) && \
echo '--- / ---' && curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|Server-side rendered at: [^<]*\|Welcome to My Blog' | head -5 && \
echo '--- /blog ---' && curl -s localhost:3000/blog | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' && \
echo '--- /blog/1 ---' && curl -s localhost:3000/blog/1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|Comments ([0-9]*)' && \
echo '--- /nope (status) ---' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3000/does-not-exist && \
echo '--- GET /api/posts ---' && curl -s localhost:3000/api/posts && echo && \
echo '--- POST /api/posts (valid) ---' && curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"t","content":"c"}' && echo && \
echo '--- POST /api/posts (invalid) ---' && curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]' -X POST localhost:3000/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' && echo && \
echo '--- PUT /api/posts/5 ---' && curl -s -X PUT localhost:3000/api/posts/5 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"new"}' && echo && \
echo '--- DELETE /api/posts/5 ---' && curl -s -X DELETE localhost:3000/api/posts/5 && echo && \
echo '--- PATCH /api/posts (405?) ---' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} allow=%header{allow}\n' -X PATCH localhost:3000/api/posts; kill $(cat /tmp/next.pid) 2>/dev/null; wait 2>/dev/null; true
